Yuki, the owner (same owner as Circle Sushi which is my favorite sushi spot in all of Atlanta) flies in the freshest fish from the same markets in Japan that other Michelin starred spots here in Atlanta, but isn’t charging quite the same prices. The quality is amazing, but so is the variety. There were a few rare nigiri types I had never tried before! Every bite from Chef Horie was as beautiful as it was delicious, and even the tableware here is so thoughtfully curated. It’s about 17 courses, and is $225 for non-members, and $185 for members (membership comes with other fun perks in addition to the discount). The A5 Wagyu hand roll will blow your mind and is worth every penny. They also have Sake Flights and other beverages if you’d like to pair that with the experience. Downstairs, they offer beautiful donburis (fish over rice), and are open for lunch now as well! Palais Kinsky Palais Kinsky is free to enter, offering a glimpse of its Baroque architecture, including the grand staircase and painted ceiling. 3. Austrian Parliament Free guided tours of Palais Epstein are available every Saturday, along with the Parliament Building’s impressive neo-Greek architecture. 4. Vienna Parks Vienna’s parks, like Burggarten and Volksgarten, are perfect for a peaceful stroll. In autumn, they are especially beautiful as the leaves change, creating a vibrant setting. 5. Palace of Justice The Palace of Justice offers free access and a rooftop café with stunning views of the city. 6. Free Museums On the first Sunday of the month, museums like the Beethoven Museum or Hermesvilla offer free entry. Kunsthalle Wien offers free entry every Thursday from 5pm to 9pm. 7.
